subject: A newsletter column for Databar tables
body:
Databar's provider list covers firmographics, funding, tech stack, hiring, traffic, reviews and news across 160+ live providers. What it does not carry is the publication itself: no newsletter object, no article to publication attribution, no sponsor to publication pair and no momentum on the list.

The category you sell into is already measured in that layer. Clay sits in 92 articles across 56 publications, Apollo in 102 across 88, ZoomInfo in 25 across 19.

A NewsletterFIT record is a newsletter with its audience and the basis for that figure, the topics it covers, the sponsors running in it, how the list is trending, and the articles behind each fact. AI reads the issues, so a table gets structured fields rather than text to interpret.

I can send a sample export keyed by domain so the join is testable before a connector exists. Same records over REST and MCP.
